title: Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938): Pre-auth RCE in OpenJDK, and the challenge of image and feature bloat
content_md: On 11/17/26, Oracle and OpenJDK shipped fixes for Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938), a heap memory corruption bug in the AVX-512 accelerated Base64 decoder. Article Link: Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938): Pre-auth RCE in OpenJDK, and the challenge of image and feature bloat | Sysdig
